name: Golden
blurb: HUNTR/X's power anthem from KPop Demon Hunters (2025), famous for its sky-high note
title: Golden by HUNTR/X: Why the KPop Demon Hunters Song Went Viral
description: "Golden" is the anthem of HUNTR/X, the fictional girl group in Netflix's KPop Demon Hunters, sung by EJAE, Audrey Nuna and REI AMI. Its high note became a TikTok challenge.
answer: "Golden" is the signature song of HUNTR/X, the fictional K-pop girl group in Netflix's animated film KPop Demon Hunters, released on 20 June 2025. It is sung by EJAE (Rumi's voice), Audrey Nuna (Mira) and REI AMI (Zoey). As the film became a worldwide hit, fans on TikTok flooded the app with covers trying to hit the song's very high chorus note, and "Golden" spent 8 weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and later won a Grammy and the Oscar for Best Original Song.

body: The main trend is a vocal challenge: people film themselves attempting the soaring note in the chorus, often failing in funny ways, while vocal coaches post tutorials on how to reach it. There are also lip-syncs, dance covers, instrumental versions and kids singing along in costume. Real K-pop idols posted their own takes, which pushed the trend further.

head: Date
Event
rows: KPop Demon Hunters and its soundtrack are released on Netflix.
"Golden" is released as a single through Republic Records.
It reaches No. 1 on the UK Singles Chart and, on the chart dated 16 August, the Billboard Hot 100.
It totals 8 weeks at No. 1 on the Hot 100, the longest run for an animated act.
It finishes an 18-week run at No. 1 on the Billboard Global 200, the longest of 2025.
Wins Best Song Written for Visual Media at the 68th Grammys, the first Grammy for a K-pop song.
Wins Best Original Song at the 98th Academy Awards.

body: In the film, HUNTR/X are idols who secretly hunt demons, and "Golden" is the single meant to seal the "Golden Honmoon", a permanent magic barrier that protects the world. It is an "I want" song about who they are meant to be: shining and no longer hiding. The bridge turns to Rumi's private feelings, since she is secretly half-demon.

body.note: HUNTR/X is fictional, but the singers are real, and EJAE also co-wrote the song with Mark Sonnenblick.

ul: Billboard Global 200: 18 non-consecutive weeks at No. 1.
UK Singles Chart: 10 weeks at No. 1, the first K-pop No. 1 there since "Gangnam Style".
Grammys: four nominations including Song of the Year; won Best Song Written for Visual Media.
Oscars: Best Original Song, the first K-pop song to win it.

faq.q: Who sings "Golden" in KPop Demon Hunters?
faq.a: EJAE (singing voice of Rumi), Audrey Nuna (Mira) and REI AMI (Zoey), credited as HUNTR/X.

faq.q: What is the Golden high note challenge?
faq.a: People film themselves trying to sing the highest note of the chorus, which is very hard for most voices, and post the result, success or fail.
No. HUNTR/X is the fictional group from the film, but the three singers who voice it are real and have performed the song live.
